create_user: create a new internal user with budget, teams, and auto-generated API key via POST /user/new
update_user: update an existing user's role, budget, teams, or metadata via POST /user/update
bulk_update_users: bulk update multiple users or all users at once via POST /user/bulk_update
delete_users: delete users and their associated keys, invitations, and memberships via POST /user/delete
list_users: get a paginated, filtered, and sorted list of users via GET /user/list
